delivery: an invoice for each order: “Separate invoices will be generated for Flow-Through orders and regular replenishment orders.”
payment: by pre-authorized debit from the retailer's bank account: “As part of your onboarding process, you must complete a PAD agreement to pay for your orders.” … “Once the PAD process is set up, you will not be required to initiate any payments for your orders, as we will retrieve the necessary funds directly from your financial institution.”
